scrapThat.title: "Scrap that" voice reset
scrapThat.description: Say "scrap that" mid-dictation to discard everything before it and start the transcript fresh from that point. Works in every mode; in live streaming the expanded pill collapses back to the compact capsule until you speak again. Off costs nothing.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Follow the operating system, or hold Grain to a fixed light or dark scheme. Every Grain surface — window, pill and extension cards — uses this one setting.

set.title: Capture modes
set.description: Grain has three ways to capture. Keeping one means one shortcut to remember; the other modes stay available, they just stop holding a hotkey. Switch to all three whenever you want them back.

always.title: Send every capture to AI
always.description: Every capture is post-processed, whichever key started it. With this on there is exactly one shortcut to remember for the whole product.

end.title: Finish with AI
end.description: Press the AI shortcut during a capture to end it and send the transcript to AI. Off means the AI shortcut only ever starts a capture.

startMode.title: AI shortcut starts
startMode.description: Which capture mode the AI shortcut uses when you press it to begin. With one mode live it necessarily uses that one.
